title: InclusionMed: Benchmarking AI for Inclusive Healthcare
abstract: arXiv:2611.21218v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Advancing medical AI for inclusive healthcare requires evaluation across diverse healthcare roles, tasks, and care settings, but benchmark coverage remains uneven. We introduce InclusionMed, an open medical AI evaluation initiative for inclusive healthcare. The InclusionMed Atlas organizes benchmarks across three healthcare roles and three AI capabilities. For the first release, we selected four public benchmarks from 388 candidates through structured audits and independent reproduction. With InclusionMed-DxFiles, our private diagnostic reasoning benchmark, the Atlas contains five benchmarks covering three of its nine role--capability cells. We evaluated frontier large language models on the Atlas and aggregated their results into the InclusionMed Index, with overall scores ranging from 17.5 to 49.1 out of 100. translated_title: InclusionMed：面向包容性医疗保健的AI基准测试
translated_abstract: 推进面向包容性医疗保健的医学AI，需要在多样化的医疗角色、任务和诊疗场景中进行评估，但目前基准测试的覆盖范围仍不均衡。我们提出了InclusionMed，一个面向包容性医疗保健的开放式医学AI评估计划。InclusionMed Atlas（图集）按照三种医疗角色和三种AI能力对基准测试进行组织。在首次发布中，我们通过对388个候选基准进行结构化审查和独立复现，选出了四个公开基准。再加上我们的私有诊断推理基准InclusionMed-DxFiles，该图集共包含五个基准，覆盖了九个角色-能力单元中的三个。我们在该图集上评估了前沿大语言模型，并将其结果汇总为InclusionMed指数，各模型的总体得分介于17.5至49.1分（满分100分）之间。该指数还按医疗角色和AI能力分别报告得分，结果显示模型的名次会随医疗角色或AI能力的不同而变化。
tldr: 该论文提出了InclusionMed——首个面向包容性医疗保健的开放式医学AI评估体系，通过按医疗角色和AI能力组织的基准图集及综合指数，系统评估前沿大语言模型，揭示模型表现随角色和能力显著变化且整体水平仍有较大提升空间。
